# **Peanut & Honey – Stylish Kids’ Clothing Delivered to Your Door, Same Day**


Peanut & Honey, located in Brooklyn, NYC, is a destination for unique, stylish kids’ clothing and gifts. This curated collection features everything from cozy baby essentials to trendy outfits for big kids, with a focus on a year-round style that’s always on point. With a commitment to eco-conscious practices and local artisans, Peanut & Honey offers quality and charm in every piece. Thanks to Getcho’s same-day delivery service, you can have kids’ clothing delivered to your door the very day you need it—perfect for last-minute occasions or simply keeping your little one looking their best.


## **Essentials for the Little Ones (NB-24M)**


### [Snowy Speckle Knit Grandpa Roll Neck Cardigan - $59.00](https://peanutandhoney.com/)


This adorable roll-neck cardigan offers warmth and style with its speckled knit and classic “grandpa” look. Ideal for layering on chilly days, this piece combines functionality with timeless charm.


### [Snowy Speckle Knit Ribbed Legging - $49.00](https://peanutandhoney.com/)


Complete the look with these ribbed leggings in matching speckled knit. These are made for comfort and style, perfect for active little ones.


### [Cream Bear | Knit Bear Beanies - $25.00](https://peanutandhoney.com/)


Soft and adorable, our bear-themed knit beanies keep little ones warm with a hint of playful style. An essential for winter outings.


### [Flower Nacardo Blanco - $55.00](https://peanutandhoney.com/)


A delicate and adorable option for babies, the Flower Nacardo Blanco adds a soft touch of style to any little one’s wardrobe. Its subtle design complements any outfit, perfect for photo-worthy moments.


## **For Big Kids (Boys)**


### [Construction Dino Sweatshirt - $59.00](https://peanutandhoney.com/)


For dino lovers, this sweatshirt brings imagination to life with a fun mix of dinosaurs and construction themes. Perfect for chilly play days.


### [Low Splash Snow Indigo - $69.00](https://peanutandhoney.com/products/indigo-low-splash-snow?_pos=1&_psq=Low+Splash+Snow+Indigo&_ss=e&_v=1.0)


The perfect blend of comfort and rugged style, these indigo shoes are splash-proof and designed for kids on the go. With a versatile look and lasting durability, they’ll keep up with every play session.


## **For Big Kids (Girls)**


### [Scandi Cardigan with Berry Red Bows - $105.00 USD](https://peanutandhoney.com/products/scandi-cardigan-with-berry-red-bows?_pos=1&_psq=Scandi+Cardigan+with+Berry+Red+Bows&_ss=e&_v=1.0)


This cozy, chic cardigan is adorned with berry-red bows, adding a pop of color to any outfit. Perfect for chilly days.


### [Low Splash Snow Silver - $69.00](https://peanutandhoney.com/products/silver-low-splash-snow?_pos=1&_psq=low-splash-snow-silver&_ss=e&_v=1.0)


These stylish, splash-proof shoes in a sparkling silver finish are perfect for active girls who want a bit of glam. Designed for both comfort and durability, they’ll hold up through all her adventures.


---


For those last-second needs, like a fresh pair of shoes or a gift for an impromptu event, Peanut & Honey has you covered with same-day delivery through Getcho. Your chosen styles arrive right at your door, just in time to complete any outfit or brighten up a special moment.
